title: Esho Maa Lakshmi
desc: Devotees celebrate Goddess Lakshmi with prayers, rituals and heartfelt devotion, seeking prosperity, blessings and harmony in their homes and lives.

title: Abhagini
desc: Abhagini is tortured by her stepmother all her life, but she decides to make a new start after leaving the city. Initially, the new family she is living with dislikes her, but she soon wins them over.

title: Swapno
desc: A woman leaves a kind-hearted man owing to a misunderstanding and marries his younger brother. However, it turns out that he is the complete opposite of his elder brother.

title: Bourani
desc: A manipulative woman schemes to control her brother's wealth by orchestrating a marriage, but her plans begin to unravel when unexpected love enters the picture.

title: Takkar
desc: Chaitali, a rich girl, marries Arun against her family's wishes. Soon, their relationship turns sour and the bone of contention between the couple is the man's nephew.

title: Ogo Bodhu Shundori
desc: Tensions rise between a married couple with conflicting personalities as the husband offers shelter to a woman in their home.
